name: DualPools

This enabled them to use a small amount of dTokens to collateralize a large amount of other assets. DualPools was exploited on BNB Chain on 15 February 2024, losing approximately $41,000. The attacker manipulated the dLINK pool exchange rate through low-liquidity initialization and exploited a precision truncation bug, inflating collateral and borrowing assets across pools. The primary root cause was precision truncation and unsafe exchange rate initialization in a freshly minted low-liquidity dLINK pool. The protocol allowed division operations exposed to rounding and truncation errors, permitting attackers to reclaim nearly all initially deposited LINK with only minimal dLINK collateral.
